jobs.title: Cloud and Infrastructure Systems Administrator
jobs.description:
Job Title: 
Cloud & Infrastructure Systems Administrator 


Contractor Position 




Revision Date: 9/29/2025


 




Summary 
DCWATER's DIT team is looking for a Cloud & Infrastructure Systems Administrator to manage and optimize our hybrid cloud environment. This role is for a forward-thinking IT professional who is passionate about infrastructure, automation, and leveraging modern cloud and AI platforms to drive efficiency and reliability. The ideal candidate will be responsible for the full lifecycle of our server and virtual environments, from initial design and deployment to ongoing maintenance, monitoring, and continuous improvement. 
Responsibilities 
Cloud and Hybrid Infrastructure Management: Administer, configure, and maintain Microsoft Azure and AWS environments. This includes managing virtual machines, networking, storage, and identity services across both cloud and on-premises infrastructure. 
Automation and Scripting: Develop and maintain automation scripts using tools like PowerShell, Python, and Terraform to provision infrastructure, automate routine tasks, and enforce configuration consistency. Implement Infrastructure as Code (IaC) principles to manage infrastructure efficiently. 
AI for Operations (AIOps): Utilize AI-powered monitoring and log analysis platforms such as Splunk and Azure Monitor to proactively detect system anomalies, predict potential failures, and automate incident response. 
Containerization and Orchestration: Deploy and manage containerized applications using Docker and orchestrate them with Kubernetes to ensure scalability and high availability. 
Security and Compliance: Enforce security policies across all platforms. This includes managing identity and access controls with Azure Active Directory and modern IAM solutions, ensuring data encryption, and conducting regular security audits. 
Disaster Recovery and Business Continuity: Design, implement, and test modern disaster recovery and business continuity plans for both cloud-native and on-premise systems to ensure minimal downtime and data loss. 
Virtualization and Server Administration: Administer VMware vSphere and Windows Server environments, ensuring they are patched, secure, and configured for optimal performance. 
Collaboration and Improvement: Work closely with development and security teams in a DevOps and DevSecOps culture to streamline workflows and implement continuous integration/continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipelines. Provide technical expertise and mentorship to junior staff. 
System Intelligence and Machine Learning: Collaborate with data science teams to integrate intelligent agents and machine learning models for infrastructure optimization, capacity planning, and automated resource allocation. 
 
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- 
Qualifications 

5+ years of hands-on experience in a systems administration or similar role within an enterprise environment. 


Proven expertise in managing and administering cloud platforms like Microsoft Azure and/or Amazon Web Services (AWS). 


Strong experience with automation and scripting, particularly with PowerShell and/or Python. 


Experience with Microsoft Azure Entra ID, API Management, Front Door, Virtual Desktop Infrastructure, Application Proxy Gateway, Data Gateway. 


Experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools such as Terraform. 


Hands-on experience with virtualization technologies, specifically VMware vSphere. 


Experience with containerization and orchestration platforms like Docker and Kubernetes. 


Familiarity with AIOps tools and principles for predictive analysis and automated monitoring. 


Knowledge of Microsoft Office 365, Power Platform, Intune, MECM/SCCM. 


A foundational understanding of machine learning concepts, intelligent agents, and their practical application in an IT infrastructure context. 


Solid understanding of modern networking concepts, including hybrid cloud connectivity, security groups, and load balancing. 


Strong knowledge of Microsoft Active Directory and modern identity management. 


Excellent problem-solving skills, with the ability to analyze complex issues and provide effective solutions. 


Relevant certifications are a strong plus, especially Azure Administrator Associate, AWS Certified SysOps Administrator, or VMware Certified Professional (VCP). 


Bachelor’s degree in computer science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience and certifications.

jobs.title: DHCF Technical Project Manager
jobs.description:
The Technical Project Manager leads complex, engineering-driven IT initiatives across infrastructure, cloud, networking, applications, and data platforms. This role oversees the full project lifecycle—from initiation through deployment and closure—ensuring all technical deliverables are aligned with architecture standards, security requirements, and business objectives. You will act as a technical facilitator and execution leader, coordinating engineers, architects, operations teams, cybersecurity, vendors, and business stakeholders to deliver secure, scalable, and reliable technology solutions.
Key Responsibilities


Technical Planning & Execution: Define project scope, engineering requirements, and success criteria. Develop comprehensive plans covering deployment strategies, cutovers, and integration milestones.


Service Migrations & Deployment: Lead end-to-end service migrations, including infrastructure transitions and network changes. Develop detailed runbooks, deployment plans, and manage go-live command center operations.


Engineering Leadership: Coordinate cross-functional teams across engineering, data management, and security. Serve as an Agile facilitator/Scrum Master to drive sprint goals and process improvements.


Risk & Budget Management: Manage RAID logs, track project budgets, and ensure efficient allocation of resources, hardware, and vendor services.


Governance & Documentation: Maintain rigorous technical documentation, ensure compliance with security/audit requirements, and provide leadership with executive-level progress reports.


Skills & Qualifications
Required Experience (11+ Years)


Managing technical projects across IT infrastructure, cloud, networking, enterprise applications, and data platforms.


Leading complex service migrations, cutovers, integrations, and modernization initiatives.


Coordinating work across engineering, security, operations, and business teams in matrixed environments.


Applying Agile (Scrum/SAFe), SDLC, DevOps workflows, and ITIL processes.


Managing project budgets.


Technical Expertise


Networking: TCP/IP, routing/switching, firewalls, DNS, LAN/WAN, SD-WAN, proxies, NAT.


Systems: Linux/Unix, clustering, virtualization, servers, storage, DBA experience.


Cloud & Data: AWS foundational knowledge; experience with data pipelines, BI tools, ETL, and data quality.


Programming/Automation: Java, shell scripting, PL/SQL, API integrations.


Tools: Jira, Confluence, Smartsheet, Azure DevOps, ServiceNow, MS Project, Visio, M365.


Environment: Familiarity with enterprise monitoring, observability, security tools, and CI/CD.


Education & Certifications


Education: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a closely related technical field.


Certifications: PMP or CSM are highly desired. Must qualify for a Senior Level STaR2 labor category.

jobs.title: NCDOT - Technical Specialist - Junior - Normal
jobs.description:
Job Summary:
The Junior Technical Specialist in Raleigh, NC, supports the NC DIT-Transportation Accounts Team by providing advanced technical expertise in account and access management, particularly with Active Directory. This hybrid role involves remote work with occasional onsite presence for training and equipment collection. The specialist ensures IT security compliance, resolves technical incidents, and leads projects to enhance operational efficiency.
Responsibilities:

Analyze and modify accounts for new and existing employees.
Troubleshoot data and application access issues and adjust Active Directory properties as needed.
Receive, log, and document requests and incidents using ServiceNow, providing resolutions and weekly status reports to management.
Implement IT Security Office requirements to protect data from unauthorized access or misuse.
Provide advanced support and guidance across a broad range of technologies.
Lead projects, direct team efforts, and report project status to management.
Create and maintain documentation of processes and procedures aligned with operational and service level agreements.
Maintain awareness of DOT and ITS security policies and apply them in daily operations.


Required Skills & Certifications:

Minimum 3 years of experience administering Microsoft Active Directory 2008/2012 in multi-site, multi-domain environments.
Strong knowledge of account management and IT security measures.
Proven ability to analyze client needs and develop effective technical solutions.
Experience using ServiceNow for incident management and documentation.
Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written.
Demonstrated customer orientation and problem-solving skills.
Ability to work independently with strong initiative and time management.
Current residence in North Carolina is mandatory.

Preferred Skills & Certifications:

Project management experience with ability to lead teams and coordinate work.
Experience with IT infrastructure operations and security in transportation or government environments.
Familiarity with DOT and ITS security policies and standards.
Advanced troubleshooting and system analysis capabilities.

Special Considerations:

This is a hybrid role requiring remote work with occasional onsite visits for training and equipment pickup.
First day onsite attendance is mandatory for equipment collection.
Absences longer than two weeks require prior approval and must include reachable contact information.
Candidate must comply with all IT security policies and protect sensitive data accordingly.

Scheduling:

Work schedule primarily remote with occasional onsite requirements.
Standard business hours with potential flexibility as needed for project and operational demands.

jobs.title: NCDOT - Technical Specialist
jobs.location: Century Center, 1020 Birch Ridge Dr, Raleigh NC 27519
jobs.description:
Job Summary:
The Mainframe Technical Specialist in Raleigh, NC is responsible for analyzing, coding, testing, and modifying legacy mainframe applications. This role involves working with complex program modules, documenting requirements and deliverables, and ensuring quality control for project outcomes. The position requires extensive experience in mainframe programming, particularly with CICS and COBOL environments, supporting corporate or government projects.
Responsibilities:

Analyze, define, and document requirements for data and business processes.
Design, document, and coordinate changes to legacy program modules.
Code and test new and existing modules for major modifications to legacy applications.
Document program and project deliverables as assigned.
Analyze and estimate feasibility and compatibility with other programs and projects.
Provide quality control for project deliverables.

Required Skills & Certifications:

Minimum 10 years of experience as a programmer analyst in corporate or government environments.
At least 5 years of experience exposing CICS and COBOL programs as web services via CICS Transaction Server (CTS) and/or CICS Transaction Gateway (CTG).
Proven expertise in mainframe programming techniques and languages.
Strong knowledge of computer programming principles, testing, debugging, implementation, and documentation.
Experience with analysis and design of software systems.

Preferred Skills & Certifications:

Experience working with legacy application modernization projects.
Familiarity with project feasibility and compatibility analysis.

Special Considerations:

Work involves handling complex legacy systems requiring thorough documentation and quality control.

Scheduling:

Regular shift from 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM EST.
Position duration is 12+ months with possibility of extension.

jobs.title: Senior Network Engineer
jobs.description:
Job Summary:
The Senior Network Engineer role based in Washington, DC involves supporting the stability, performance, and security of enterprise and data center network infrastructures. This position focuses on managing Cisco-based networking environments, including Catalyst and Nexus platforms, wireless networks, ISE, and IPS, to ensure high availability, security compliance, and continuous operations.
Responsibilities:

Design, implement, and maintain internal and external network infrastructure supporting critical business applications.
Support day-to-day network operations including routing and switching troubleshooting, maintenance, and operational support.
Develop and implement new network designs and improvements to enhance performance, resiliency, and scalability.
Plan and execute network upgrades in collaboration with internal teams.
Proactively monitor and analyze network health using enterprise monitoring and management platforms.
Participate in cloud migration and hybrid network initiatives.
Ensure network availability, security, and compliance with enterprise standards.

Required Skills & Certifications:

Minimum of 8 years’ experience supporting enterprise-grade routers and switches in large data center environments.
Expert-level knowledge of BGP and OSPF, including traffic engineering, route optimization, and failover design.
Strong expertise in TCP/IP troubleshooting and packet analysis.
Hands-on experience configuring and supporting BGP, OSPF, and STP on Cisco NX-OS and IOS-XE platforms.
Experience with Cisco Nexus (9K, 7K) and Catalyst switches and routers.
Proven experience designing, planning, testing, implementing, and troubleshooting large-scale data center networks.
Experience with network management and monitoring tools such as SolarWinds and Cisco Catalyst Center.
Experience with cloud networking and hybrid network architectures.
Ability to clearly articulate and provide examples of designing and implementing BGP and/or OSPF routing architectures, troubleshooting complex routing issues, and supporting or leading data center network deployments or migrations.

Preferred Skills & Certifications:

Experience with cloud migration and hybrid network initiatives.
Familiarity with Cisco Identity Services Engine (ISE) and Intrusion Prevention Systems (IPS).

Special Considerations:

Role requires ensuring continuous network availability and security compliance.
May involve participation in on-call rotations or emergency response for network issues.

Scheduling:

6-month contract duration.
Typical enterprise network engineer work schedule; specific shifts or hours not specified.

jobs.title: GA DDS IT Support Specialist 3
jobs.location: DDS Headquarters, 2206 Eastview Pkwy NE, Conyers, GA 30013
jobs.description:
Job Summary:
The IT Support Specialist will maintain and support critical business applications and infrastructure, focusing on DDS systems such as Nemo Q/GALA, VRT cameras, A/V, and mobile systems. This role involves triaging production incidents, collaborating with partners to restore services, and implementing improvements to prevent future issues. The specialist will also design and maintain cloud environments, automate processes, and provide timely customer support to enhance operational efficiency.
Responsibilities:

Maintain cost-efficient, scalable cloud environments aligned with business objectives.
Design, build, and maintain internal cloud applications.
Stay current with cloud computing best practices and implement infrastructure improvements.
Make hardware and software recommendations based on project and organizational needs.
Utilize automation and provisioning technologies such as AWS CLI and Terraform.
Monitor and respond to ServiceNow ticket queues promptly and provide follow-up support.
Provide customer support for software, configurations, and business submission processes.
Identify opportunities to digitize tasks and improve operational workflows.
Minimize data leakage and system downtime.
Assist IT Infrastructure team members and escalate issues when necessary.
Troubleshoot and support PCs, laptops (Windows 10/11), scanners, network printers, Google Print, Chrome boxes, and other field systems.
Act as administrator or subject matter expert for lobby management software and other DDS applications as needed.

Required Skills & Certifications:

Experience with cloud environments and cloud-based application design.
Proficiency with automation and provisioning tools such as AWS CLI and Terraform.
Strong knowledge of Windows 10/11 systems and peripheral device troubleshooting.
Familiarity with ServiceNow or similar ticketing systems.
Ability to manage and support DDS systems and related technologies.
Excellent problem-solving and incident management skills.

Preferred Skills & Certifications:

Experience with lobby management software and agency-specific DDS applications.
Knowledge of A/V systems and mobile system support.
Certifications related to cloud platforms (e.g., AWS Certified Solutions Architect) or IT support.
Experience with Google Print and Chrome devices.

Special Considerations:

Must be willing to continuously learn and stay updated on emerging IT technologies.
Ability to work collaboratively with multiple partners to restore services quickly.
Attention to minimizing data leakage and downtime is critical.

Scheduling:

Regular shift from 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM EST.
Position duration is 12+ months with possibility of extension.
